chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Sukkari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Zakariyya narrated to us. He said: Umayr ibn Imran narrated to us. He said: Sulayman ibn Amr al-Nakha'i narrated to us, from Rib'i ibn Khirash, from Hudhayfa ibn al-Yaman. He said:

I saw the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) holding the hand of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both), and he was saying: O people! This is al-Husayn ibn Ali, so recognize him. For by the One in whose hand is my soul, he will surely be in Paradise, and his lovers will be in Paradise, and the lovers of his lovers will be in Paradise.

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Al-Janna - Paradise: the eternal abode of the righteous in the Hereafter
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ: Al-Husayn ibn Ali: the grandson of the Prophet, third Imam of the Shia, known as the Master of the Martyrs
key_terms.مُحِبِّيهِ: Muhibbihi - His lovers: those who hold sincere devotion and love for al-Husayn (as)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about al-Husayn ibn Ali and Paradise in al-Amali of al-Saduq?
ai.summary: Hudhayfa ibn al-Yaman reports witnessing the Prophet Muhammad (s) hold the hand of al-Husayn ibn Ali (as) and publicly declare to the people that al-Husayn is a dweller of Paradise, as are those who love him, and those who love his lovers. This narration was transmitted during the assembly of Friday, the 28th of Rajab 368 AH, through a chain of seven narrators. The hadith highlights the elevated spiritual rank of Imam al-Husayn (as) in the eyes of the Prophet and the meritorious status of devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. `Ali al-Sikri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya narrated to us. He said: `Umayr b. `Imran narrated to us. He said: Sulayman b. `Amr al-Nakha`i narrated to us from Rabi`i b. Khurash from Hudhayfa b. al-Yaman. He said:

I saw the Prophet (s) take the hand of al-Husayn b. `Ali (as), saying: O people! This is al-Husayn b. `Ali. Recognize him, for by Him in whose hand is my soul, he will be in Paradise, and his lovers will be in Paradise, and his lovers’ lovers will be in Paradise.
